name: S'mores
equipment: pack's reusable roasting skewers (bring them; no purchase)
notes: Kids go wild: planned ~3.5 s'mores per kid, ~1.5 per adult, per night.
Marshmallows carry a +50% burn/drop allowance; grahams +15% for breakage.
Vegan (gelatin-free) marshmallows go in a separate, labeled bag for vegetarian, halal and kosher eaters. Regular marshmallows are usually pork gelatin.
Storage: bag opened grahams, chocolate and marshmallows in gallon bags and put them in a sealed bin or car overnight (critters).
roles: Fire lead (1 adult): fire, and the roasting line
Station lead (1 adult) + AOL scouts: trays, handing out marshmallows, hot chocolate

steps.text: Start the fire early; roasting works best over coals, not tall flames. Keep a bucket of water next to the fire ring.
Trays: break graham crackers ({graham_crackers}) into squares; break chocolate bars ({chocolate_bars}) into squares. Set out the pack's reusable skewers.
Vegan marshmallows ({marshmallows_vegan}) go on their OWN labeled tray, with their own skewers if possible (regular marshmallows are pork gelatin).

serving: Hand out marshmallows 2 at a time; they'll burn and drop a lot, and that's planned for.
Kids assemble on a napkin or paper towel away from the fire.
About 3-4 per kid over the night; slow it down if the trays empty too fast.
food_safety: Skewers point down when walking; no running near the fire.
A flaming marshmallow gets blown out and cooled before eating; it's hotter than it looks.
One adult stays at the fire the whole time.
cleanup: Wipe and wash the reusable skewers; count them back into the bin.
Bag opened grahams, chocolate and marshmallows; store them in a sealed bin or car overnight (critters).
Drown, stir and drown the fire before bed.

diet.vegetarian: Vegan marshmallows from the labeled tray.
diet.halal: Vegan marshmallows from the labeled tray.
diet.kosher: Vegan (kosher-certified) marshmallows from the labeled tray; check the graham and chocolate symbols.
diet.gluten_free: Graham crackers have wheat; bring GF grahams.
diet.nut_free: Check the chocolate label for nuts and 'may contain'.
